title: 영어브리핑_2026-10-24
korean_summary: 내일 핵심: LRQA 근무 전 회의·점심 작업 차단 법인장 보고·공지, 조키펌프 전자결재(견적 10/26 만료), Hao 기계임대 리스트 수령. (10/23 07:40 기준 작성, 오늘 메일 미반영)
paragraphs: Good morning, Anthony. Today is Saturday, October twenty-fourth. It is the last working day of the week, but there is still important work.

This briefing has seven parts. First, the top three items for today. Second, reports you need to collect. Third, replies you owe. Fourth, your schedule and deadlines. Fifth, an English review. Sixth, a short role-play. Then a closing.
Please listen slowly. When you hear a pause, say the sentence out loud. Let's begin.
Part one. Top three for today.
Number one. The LRQA follow-up. LRQA is the social audit company.

What happened? On October twenty-second, An sent a report. Some departments still hold meetings at seven thirty, before working hours. Also, sewing line managers, leaders, and workers keep working during lunch time.

Why does it matter? During the audit, the auditor gave a clear warning. A meeting before working hours counts as overtime. If an audit finds it, the factory may have to pay one year of unpaid overtime. We promised to fix this. Now the problem is back. Channa is no longer in Danang, and Chamin leaves on October thirty-first. So control on the sewing floor is weak.

Your first action today. Check if you already reported this to Mr Moon on Friday. If not, report it this morning with An's file. Suggest a notice in Mr Moon's name. Also suggest physical steps, like turning off the lights at lunch and closing the line entrance.
Number two. Two approvals from the top. You need to submit them in the system.

The first one is the jockey pump for the fire system. Mr Moon said, "OK, put it in e-approval." The supplier quote is valid only until Monday, October twenty-sixth. If the quote expires, we may need a new price.

The second one is the clear plastic curtain for the firewood storage. Chloe Kim said the top management approved it. She asked us to submit it as an ERP maintenance purchase. After installation, she wants photos.

Your first action today. If the pump e-approval is not done, do it first. Then check with Mai. Ask her to enter the curtain in ERP today. In the same message, remind her about moving twenty broken pallets to the firewood storage. Mai often needs a reminder, so check again before lunch.
Number three. People and payroll.

First, the short-term salary. Hoang sent the October list for short-term workers. Payment is on Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. Our rule is to review it four working days before payment. That date has already passed. If you have not replied yet, reply today with your OK or your questions.

Second, Asanka, the new sewing manager. He wants to start on November fifteenth. His police record takes about fourteen days. Harry Heo at head office asked us to share the start date. Tho was preparing a visa comparison. PIT does not use a visa agent, so there is nothing to compare. Tho recommends a three-month e-visa.
Your first action today. Check if Hoang's salary and the Harry Heo update are done. If not, finish both before ten o'clock.
Part two. Reports to collect.

First, Hao from the maintenance team. His deadline is today. He must send the machine rental list for November. Ian Kim at head office needs it by Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. Check that every rented machine has a model, a quantity, and a monthly period. If it is not in your inbox by noon, send a short reminder.
The sentence you can use is this. "Hi Hao, I'm following up on the November machine rental list. Could you send it by three p.m. today?"

Second, Quan from IT. Saturday is his routine day. He should confirm three things. The security guard training photos. The DN CMP file. And the new monitor in the PC asset list. Check that the monitor has an asset number and a user name.
The sentence you can use is this. "Hi Quan, once the monitor is logged in the PC list, please send me a screenshot."

Third, Tho from HR. You asked her to check the leave pass rule file. Also, the collective bargaining agreement, called the CBA, ends on November twenty-fourth. She is waiting for Mr Moon's decision. So today, just check the leave pass file.
The sentence you can use is this. "Hi Tho, could you confirm whether the leave pass rule file is final?"

Fourth, Trinh Tran, the chief accountant. She owes you two things. The CMP file on a repeat-order basis, and the accounting team roles update. The roles update is due on Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. If the CMP file is still missing, ask once more.
The sentence you can use is this. "Hi Trinh, the CMP file is still outstanding. Please send it today if possible."
Fifth, Hien from import and export. You asked for nineteen missing lot numbers in the QR system. That was seven days ago. It is time for a firm reminder.
The sentence you can use is this. "Hi Hien, please obtain the lot numbers from the warehouse and update the QR system by Monday."
Part three. Replies I owe.

First, Mai, about the relaxing racks. She sent three quotes for thirty-nine racks. Compare price, size, and delivery time. Then prepare a short report for Mr Moon. Your first line could be this. "Hi Mai, thank you for the three quotes. Could you negotiate a better unit price with the lowest supplier?"

Second, Mai again, about the waterproof sheet. She sent a quote for the point two millimeter plastic sheet. This is for the leak spots in the cutting area. Your first line could be this. "Hi Mai, I checked the sheet quote. Please verify the size covers each leak point."

Third, Trinh Do from import and export, about the GOH hanging sheet. GOH means garments on hanger. MR will keep their old sheet. Trinh Do suggests one packing staff to watch every GOH loading. Your first line could be this. "Hi Trinh, I agree. Let's assign one packing staff to check every GOH loading."

Fourth, Hao, about the sponging machine. He sent new quotes from two suppliers. But he put Sunday supervision labor inside the supplier quote. Check if this goes around our internal rule. Your first line could be this. "Hi Hao, I'd like to highlight one point in the quote. Sunday labor should not be inside the supplier price."
Fifth, Quan, about the MAIKA cutting machine check. This has waited six days. Give a clear yes or no.
Sixth, check pending e-approvals from Trinh Tran. Purchase requests forty, forty-one, and forty-two, and the new vendor MAXPEED. The MAXPEED one is fourteen days old. Close it or ask what is missing.
Part four. Schedule and deadlines.
There are no meetings on your calendar for today.
Today, Saturday. Hao's machine rental list. Quan's weekly items.
Monday, October twenty-sixth. The weekly firewood report to Chloe Kim. It is on your calendar. Also, the jockey pump quote expires on this day.
Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. Short-term salary payment. Machine rental list to Ian Kim. The first CM application for November. And the accounting team roles update.

Coming soon. On Friday, October thirtieth, the security pledge report and the third-quarter tax prepayment. On Saturday, October thirty-first, the fabric and thread stock count. Chamin also leaves on that day.
Part five. English review.
Let's review the words from your English cards. Listen, then repeat.

The expression is obtain. It means to get something, often with effort. For example, please obtain a quote from the visa agent. Now say it with me. Please obtain a quote from the visa agent. ... ... ... One more time. Please obtain a quote from the visa agent. ... ... ...

The expression is log. It means to write down a result or a number. For example, please log the roller temperature during the test. Now say it with me. Please log the roller temperature during the test. ... ... ... One more time. Please log the roller temperature during the test. ... ... ...

The expression is comply with. It means to follow a rule or a standard. For example, this chemical complies with the buyer list. Now say it with me. This chemical complies with the buyer list. ... ... ... One more time. This chemical complies with the buyer list. ... ... ...

The expression is assign. It means to give a task to a person. For example, please assign one packing staff to the GOH loading. Now say it with me. Please assign one packing staff to the GOH loading. ... ... ... One more time. Please assign one packing staff to the GOH loading. ... ... ...

The expression is brief. It means to explain something in a short way. For example, please brief the team leaders on the new rule. Now say it with me. Please brief the team leaders on the new rule. ... ... ... One more time. Please brief the team leaders on the new rule. ... ... ...

The expression is "Once something, please do something." It means after one thing is done, do the next. For example, once the test is done, please send me the photos. Now say it with me. Once the test is done, please send me the photos. ... ... ... One more time. Once the test is done, please send me the photos. ... ... ...

The expression is "Until something, please continue to do something." It means keep doing it until a change. For example, until we confirm the result, please continue to use the old chemical. Now say it with me. Until we confirm the result, please continue to use the old chemical. ... ... ... One more time. Until we confirm the result, please continue to use the old chemical. ... ... ...

The expression is "I'd like to highlight." It means I want to point out something important. For example, I'd like to highlight two points before we decide. Now say it with me. I'd like to highlight two points before we decide. ... ... ... One more time. I'd like to highlight two points before we decide. ... ... ...
Now eight expressions from Thursday.

The expression is verify. It means to check that something is correct. For example, please verify the pump model on the nameplate. Now say it with me. Please verify the pump model on the nameplate. ... ... ... One more time. Please verify the pump model on the nameplate. ... ... ...

The expression is outstanding. It means not done or not sent yet. For example, the photos are still outstanding. Now say it with me. The photos are still outstanding. ... ... ... One more time. The photos are still outstanding. ... ... ...

The expression is "Could you confirm whether." It means please check if something is true. For example, could you confirm whether the price includes delivery? Now say it with me. Could you confirm whether the price includes delivery? ... ... ... One more time. Could you confirm whether the price includes delivery? ... ... ...

The expression is "I'm following up on." It means I am contacting you again about something. For example, I'm following up on the quote I asked for. Now say it with me. I'm following up on the quote I asked for. ... ... ... One more time. I'm following up on the quote I asked for. ... ... ...

The expression is significant. It means large or important. For example, there is a significant price gap between the two quotes. Now say it with me. There is a significant price gap between the two quotes. ... ... ... One more time. There is a significant price gap between the two quotes. ... ... ...

The expression is feasible. It means possible to do in real life. For example, please let me know if this sheet is feasible on the floor. Now say it with me. Please let me know if this sheet is feasible on the floor. ... ... ... One more time. Please let me know if this sheet is feasible on the floor. ... ... ...

The expression is negotiate. It means to talk to get a better price or deal. For example, please negotiate a better unit price with the supplier. Now say it with me. Please negotiate a better unit price with the supplier. ... ... ... One more time. Please negotiate a better unit price with the supplier. ... ... ...

The expression is "If something, we could do something first." It means a small first step when we are not sure. For example, if we are still unsure, we could install one pump first. Now say it with me. If we are still unsure, we could install one pump first. ... ... ... One more time. If we are still unsure, we could install one pump first. ... ... ...
Part six. Role-play.
Here is a real situation for today. You report the LRQA problem to Mr Moon in his office. Listen to the talk.
Anthony: Good morning, Mr Moon. Do you have five minutes?
Mr Moon: Sure. What is it?
Anthony: I'd like to highlight one compliance issue. An reported that the seven thirty meetings are still happening.
Mr Moon: Still? We told them to start after seven twenty-seven.
Anthony: Yes. Also, some sewing lines keep working during lunch time.
Mr Moon: Why is that a big problem?
Anthony: The auditor said a meeting before work counts as overtime. If they find it again, we may pay one year of overtime.
Mr Moon: I see. What do you suggest?
Anthony: First, a notice in your name. Second, we turn off the lights at lunch. Third, we close the line entrance.
Mr Moon: OK. Who will check it every day?
Anthony: I will assign An to check it. She will log the result every day.
Mr Moon: Good. Prepare the notice today.
Anthony: Yes. Once you sign it, I will brief the team leaders.
Now, let's practice two key sentences.
The first sentence. I'd like to highlight one compliance issue. ... ... ... One more time. I'd like to highlight one compliance issue. ... ... ...
The second sentence. Once you sign it, I will brief the team leaders. ... ... ... One more time. Once you sign it, I will brief the team leaders. ... ... ...
Great job.
Part seven. Closing.
Here is the one thing to do today. Stop the before-work meetings and lunch-time work with a notice from Mr Moon, and submit the jockey pump before the quote expires.
Have a safe ride, Anthony. See you on Monday.
